text.en: 1. This Order is the Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Home Improvement Programme) Order 2022 and comes into operation on 9 February 2022.

heading.en: Declaration of precincts for Home Improvement Programme

text.en: 2. The parts of the housing estates of the Board described in the Schedule are declared to be precincts for the purpose of carrying out upgrading works in connection with the Home Improvement Programme.

THE SCHEDULE
1. All that part of the housing estate of the Board bounded by Hougang Avenue 6, Hougang Avenue 8 and Hougang Avenue 10, comprised in Lot number 06305V in Mukim 22 and on which Apartment Blocks 417, 418, 419, 420, 421, 429, 430, 431, 432, 433 and 434 are erected, and in Lot number 09452P in Mukim 22 and on which Apartment Blocks 422, 423, 424, 425, 426, 427 and 428 are erected, and which is more particularly edged in Plan 1.
PLAN 1
HOUGANG AVENUE 6 / HOUGANG AVENUE 8 /
HOUGANG AVENUE 10
2. All that part of the housing estate of the Board bounded by Pasir Ris Drive 6, Pasir Ris Drive 3 and Pasir Ris Street 41, comprised in Lot number 01743K in Mukim 31 and on which Apartment Blocks 467, 468, 469, 470 and 471 are erected, and in Lot number 05305K in Mukim 31 and on which Apartment Blocks 472, 473, 474, 475, 476 and 477 are erected, and which is more particularly edged in Plan 2.
PLAN 2
PASIR RIS DRIVE 6
3. All that part of the housing estate of the Board bounded by Yishun Ring Road, Yishun Avenue 6 and Yishun Avenue 11, comprised in Lot number 01325X in Mukim 19 and on which Apartment Blocks 401, 402, 403, 404, 405, 406 and 409 are erected, and in Lot number 03944C in Mukim 19 and on which Apartment Blocks 410, 411, 412, 413, 414, 415, 416, 417, 418 and 419 are erected, and which is more particularly edged in Plan 3.
PLAN 3
YISHUN RING ROAD / YISHUN AVENUE 6 / YISHUN AVENUE 11
